description: This is a PHP source file defining the WorkShiftAPI class, which handles CRUD operations for work shifts in an HR management system. It includes methods for listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting work shift records, with associated validation rules and API documentation annotations.

classes.name: WorkShiftAPI
classes.description: API controller class for managing work shift entities, providing RESTful CRUD operations with inline OpenAPI documentation annotations.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all work shifts with support for sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve a specific work shift by ID.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST request to create a new work shift record.

methods.name: setParamsToWorkShift
methods.description: Helper method to set properties of a WorkShift entity from request parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for listing work shifts.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for retrieving a single work shift.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove one or more work shifts.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing work shift.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
